catalog.container_strategy: Build native C/C++ ITT APIs and the reference collector from pinned source in dev, preserve licenses and Fortran sources, and export only Linux libraries. The multi-OS release ZIP is an unselected alternative.

deployment.fortran_strategy: Upstream CMake passes the Intel-specific -module flag; explicit gfortran -J commands build these modules with the admitted GNU Fortran version. Rebuild modules for any other compiler ABI.
deployment.python_binding_strategy: The release ZIP offers separate Python distribution 1.2.2 wheels. It is not silently installed as native SDK version 3.28.4; select and hash the matching Python ABI wheel before enabling Python bindings.

catalog.purpose: Mark tasks, phases and regions for VTune and profiling analysis without changing formal timing workloads.
qualification_gaps: A physical target CPU, kernel, PMU and container launch profile must pass feature-specific collection probes; an installed executable is not full runtime qualification.
The reference deployment commands are not an executed container qualification.
C/C++, reference-collector and GNU Fortran build recipes require native execution qualification; Python wheels are a separately admitted ABI-specific optional binding.
Intel Processor Trace marker support is a target-dependent optional build and must be qualified separately.
